summary: The foreign private issuer reported results of an extraordinary general meeting held on July 10, 2026, where shareholders approved a Voting Rights Variation (increasing Class B share votes from 15 to 50 per share) and adoption of Second Amended and Restated Memorandum and Articles. No special-situation economic event occurred; the filing is a routine current report on Form 6-K describing a governance change without any acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or other special situation. The approval was routine corporate governance.
